description:
Beyond the sea, the greatest love awaits.
This time, I will save her!

Romi is enjoying happy days with her best friend, Heartsping. But she and her mother, Belita, often clash over the things Romi wants to do and the things she is expected to do. Then, one day, a mysterious incident rocks the ocean, and her mother vanishes beneath the waves without a trace.

Having lost her mother without a chance to apologise or give her one last hug, Romi finds the courage to venture into the unfamiliar ocean with Heartsping, a boy from the sea named Kite, and three other Teeniepings.

Together, they face a dazzling underwater city and enormous creatures of the deep. Along the way, Romi uncovers a secret her mother never told her.

(Source: SAMG Entertainment)
